mentions.name: pikku
mentions.description: A TypeScript server library and framework that statically analyzes code on top of tsc to extract metadata, so a single function can be consumed as an HTTP route, WebSocket, queue, scheduled job, AI tool, workflow step, or gateway (e.g. WhatsApp). It offers transport-agnostic wires for HTTP, WebSockets, queues, and scheduled jobs that run anywhere (lambdas, cron jobs, serverless, local), and addons — pikku TypeScript packages whose functions are auto-imported and handle their own service initialization. An addon-based console visualizes the codebase's functions and permissions with no backend of its own, reusing the app's unified permissions/auth system. AI agent features include subagent flows, tools, approvals, and AI middleware that turns input and output into voices, and a BuildYourAgent portal converts an OpenAPI doc into an MCP server, hooks it up to an agent, and wraps it with a CLI. The author is also seeking a potential cofounder for the project.
